terbaru.judul: Fast Authenticated and Interoperable Multimedia Healthcare Data over Hybrid-Storage Blockchains
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we propose FAITH, an innovative scheme for \underline{F}ast \underline{A}uthenticated and \underline{I}nteroperable mul\underline{T}imedia \underline{H}ealthcare data storage and sharing over hybrid-storage blockchains.

terbaru.judul: VeilAudit: Breaking the Deadlock Between Privacy and Accountability Across Blockchains
terbaru.pelajaran: We present VeilAudit, a cross chain auditing framework that introduces Auditor Only Linkability, which allows auditors to link transaction behaviors that originate from the same anonymous entity without learning its identity.

terbaru.judul: Rationally Analyzing Shelby: Proving Incentive Compatibility in a Decentralized Storage Network
terbaru.pelajaran: We analyze Shelby -- a storage network protocol recently proposed by Aptos Labs and Jump Crypto -- and provide the first formal proof of its incentive properties.

terbaru.judul: The Impact of Sanctions on decentralised Privacy Tools: A Case Study of Tornado Cash
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper investigates the impact of sanctions on Tornado Cash, a smart contract protocol designed to enhance transaction privacy.

terbaru.judul: SNARKChain: Proof-of-Useful-Work Blockchain Consensus with General-Purpose SNARK Marketplace
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we propose a PoUW consensus protocol that computes client-outsourced SNARK proofs as a byproduct, which are simultaneously used to secure the consensus protocol.

terbaru.judul: A Scalable, Privacy-Preserving Decentralized Identity and Verifiable Data Sharing Framework based on Zero-Knowledge Proofs
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper proposes a novel, comprehensive framework that integrates DIDs and VCs with efficient Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) schemes to address this core issue.

terbaru.judul: Smart Contract-Enabled Procurement under Bounded Demand Variability: A Truncated Normal Approach
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a multi-supplier model in which a centralized retailer jointly determines the optimal smart contract adoption intensity and supplier allocation decisions.

terbaru.judul: Privacy-Preserving On-chain Permissioning for KYC-Compliant Decentralized Applications
terbaru.pelajaran: Addressing these limitations, this paper presents a novel synthesis of Self-Sovereign Identity (SSI), Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKPs), and Attribute-Based Access Control to enable privacy-preserving on-chain permissioning based on decentralized policy decisions.

terbaru.judul: PoS-CoPOR: Proof-of-Stake Consensus Protocol with Native Onion Routing Providing Scalability and DoS-Resistance
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we present PoS-CoPOR, a single-chain PoS consensus protocol that mitigates this vulnerability by integrating a native onion routing mechanism into the consensus protocol itself.
